Dr. Irene Ateljević na Erasmus+ Staff Mobility for Training programu u Copenhagen Business School | Veleučilište ASPIRA

Naši kolege iz Ureda za međunarodnu suradnju, Josip Radić i Petra Mandac, sudjelovali su u okviru Erasmus+ Staff mobilnosti na intenzivnom stručnom tečaju “Motivation and Self-Development” u TeneLearning centru na Tenerifima. Ovo međunarodno stručno usavršavanje pružilo im je vrijednu priliku za razvoj profesionalnih i osobnih kompetencija u inspirativnom okruženju jednog od najljepših španjolskih otoka.

Our colleagues from the Office for International Cooperation, Josip Radić and Petra Mandac, participated in an Erasmus+ Staff Mobility programme by attending the intensive professional training course “Motivation and Self-Development” at the TeneLearning Centre in Tenerife. This international training provided a valuable opportunity for the development of both professional and personal competences in the inspiring setting of one of Spain’s most beautiful islands.

The first day focused on hotel management, where students learned through simulations about hotel structure, the role of a manager, front desk operations, and conflict resolution among staff. A highlight of the program was a field trip to the Hilton DoubleTree Zagreb, where participants gained firsthand insight into the standards of high-category hotel operations.

On the second day, the focus shifted to banquet organization and Croatian culinary heritage. Through workshops and practical tasks, students planned and carried out formal dinner simulations and learned about specialties from various Croatian regions. The day also featured a collaboration with the renowned Lisak Catering, which shared its expertise in preparing and executing high-level events.
